data_description.flow_temp_entity: Sensor of the measured water temperature from the boiler, for example on the riser. Shown on the dashboard and used to check that the boiler really heats.

data_description.flow_temp_entity: Sensor of the measured water temperature from the boiler, for example on the riser. Shown on the dashboard and used to check that the boiler really heats.

data_description.outdoor_sensors: In priority order, the first valid one is used.
data_description.weather_entity: Used when no outdoor sensor has a valid value. Without any outdoor source the equithermal functions are disabled.

data_description.boiler_overrun: Valves stay open this long after the boiler stops. It should be at least as long as the pump overrun of the boiler.
data_description.boiler_demand_threshold: Weighted demand of all rooms that starts the boiler.
data_description.boiler_demand_hysteresis: The boiler stops below the threshold minus the hysteresis.
data_description.room_call_threshold: A room with at least this demand counts as calling.
data_description.combine: How the demand threshold and the number of calling rooms are combined.
data_description.area_weighting: Requires the area to be filled in for all rooms.
data_description.has_bypass: Bypass, differential pressure valve or a radiator without a valve head that always flows.
data_description.min_open_valves: Required before the boiler starts when the system has no bypass.

data_description.keep_alive: Repeats the current command periodically, 0 = off.
data_description.startup_grace: Outputs are not switched until all required entities are available, at most this long.
data_description.fault_recovery_time: How long the boiler must be available and match the command before leaving the fault state.
data_description.heartbeat_entity: Toggled periodically for a hardware watchdog, for example in Loxone.
data_description.flow_check_time: When the boiler runs this long and the water temperature does not rise by the given difference, the problem "boiler runs but does not heat" is reported. Only with a flow temperature sensor, 0 = off.
data_description.flow_check_rise: How much the water temperature must rise above its lowest value during the boiler run.

data.valve_check_rise: Valve check: warming of an open valve
data.valve_check_closed_rise: Valve check: warming of a closed valve at most

data_description.idle_valve_policy: When the boiler stands and nobody wants heat, and off the heating season. De-energized means that NO valve heads are open and draw no power. While the boiler runs, only the valves of rooms that want heat stay open.
data_description.exercise_duration: At least the valve travel time + 60 s.
data_description.valve_check_time: Only valves with a pipe temperature sensor. Checked only while the boiler heats and the water is hot. 0 = off.
data_description.valve_check_rise: How much the pipe of an open valve must warm up. A pipe warmer than the hot-water limit is enough too.
data_description.valve_check_closed_rise: When the pipe of a closed valve warms up more, the valve does not seem to close.
data_description.valve_check_hot: Measured water temperature from which valves are checked. Without a flow sensor after 5 minutes of firing.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Window contacts are assigned to rooms in the room settings.

data.global_window_ratio: Share of rooms with an open window
data.vent_floor_auto: Spread noticed airing to the whole floor

data_description.window_outdoor_condition: Block heating only when it is colder outside than in the room.
data_description.vent_manual: How long a room does not heat after airing is switched on. Switching it on again during airing adds this time.
data_description.vent_scope: Airing usually draughts through several rooms of a floor. Floors come from the areas of Home Assistant.
data_description.vent_floor_auto: When a room notices airing by a temperature drop, the other rooms of its floor stop heating too.

data.stop_respects_min_on: Stop respects the minimum run time

data_description.manual_durations: One button per duration, 1 to 6 values between 1 and 720 minutes.
data_description.mirror_timer_entity: Timer helper for a running countdown on the dashboard.

data.equithermal_duty_enabled: Limit boiler duty by the curve
data.boiler_fixed_flow_temp: Water temperature set on the boiler

data_description.design_flow_temp: Water temperature the house needs at the design outdoor temperature.
data_description.heating_limit: The heating season starts as soon as the mean outdoor temperature of the last 4 hours drops below this limit. It ends after 3 whole days in a row in which the 4 h mean never dropped below it.
data_description.equithermal_duty_enabled: For non-condensing boilers enable it only after verifying the minimum water temperature.
data_description.use_forecast: Mean of the damped temperature and the 24 h forecast of the weather entity, for the heating curve.

equithermal_confirm.title: Check the heating curve
equithermal_confirm.description: The design flow temperature {design_flow_temp} °C is above the water temperature set on the boiler {boiler_fixed_flow_temp} °C. The duty limit will then have little effect for most of the winter. Save anyway?

data.frost_idle_max: Maximum boiler idle time in frost

presence.title: Schedule, presence and preheating
presence.description: The house schedule applies to every room without its own schedule: on = comfort, off = setback. Who is home comes from a presence module, a group of persons or zone.home. When nobody is home, rooms in auto use the setback; during a long absence the whole house uses away. Preheating starts early enough to have comfort when the schedule switches to comfort or when someone is expected back.

data_description.house_schedule_entity: A schedule helper for the whole house: on = comfort, off = setback (night, work, school). A room can override it with its own schedule.
data_description.house_presence_entity: On or home = somebody is home. A number (zone.home) above 0 also means home. Unavailable keeps the last state.
data_description.long_away_entity: On = weekend or holiday: the whole house uses the away temperatures.
data_description.expected_return_entity: Timestamp of the next return, used for preheating.
data_description.absence_preset: Setback suits short absences: the house does not cool down too much.
data_description.preheat_enabled: Learns how fast each room heats up and starts heating ahead of time.
data_description.preheat_max: Preheating never starts earlier than this before the target time.

error.hysteresis_too_large: Hysteresis must be lower than the demand threshold.

error.notify_service_not_found: Notification service not found. Use the form notify.name.

error.forecast_needs_weather: Select a weather entity in Outdoor temperature first.

data_description.weight: Weight of the room in the boiler decision.
data_description.order: Order on the dashboard and in the scheme, 1 = first. Rooms with 0 come after the others by name.

data.sensor_grace: Short sensor drop-out: keep the value

data_description.sensor_stale_timeout: Loxone sends values only when they change, so keep this long. 0 = do not check.
data_description.sensor_grace: When a sensor stops reporting (unavailable), its last value counts this long before the other sensors take over. A short drop-out does not switch to a backup sensor with another offset. 0 = off.

data_description.valves: Switches or valve entities of the radiator heads.

data_description.valve_temp_entity: Sensor on the pipe at the valve, for example a DS18B20. Used to check that the valve really opens and closes.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Leave the contacts empty when the room has none. It then notices an open window by a fast temperature drop.

data.vent_detect: Notice airing by a temperature drop

data_description.window_invert: Use when a contact reports on for a closed window.
data_description.vent_detect: When the room temperature drops fast, the room behaves as with an open window: no heating, the valve is closed. Works without window contacts too.
data_description.vent_drop: How much the temperature must drop to count as airing.
data_description.vent_time: Within how long the drop must happen.
data_description.vent_pause: Then the room heats again once the temperature rises.
data_description.vent_max: Then the room heats again in any case.

data_description.schedule_mode: By the house schedule (Schedule, presence and preheating), or an own schedule helper for this room.
data_description.schedule_entity: Only with an own schedule: on = comfort, off = setback.
data_description.presence_entity: Absence switches the room to setback or away, see Schedule, presence and preheating.
data_description.expected_return_entity: Timestamp of the return of whoever the room's presence follows, for preheating. Without own presence the household return applies.

data_description.valve_min_state_time: Not shorter than the valve travel time.

error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.
error.eco_above_comfort: The eco temperature must not be above comfort.
error.frost_too_high: The frost temperature must be below the eco and away temperatures.
error.not_temperature_sensor: Select sensors that report a temperature.
error.sensor_range: The lowest value must be below the highest.
error.min_state_too_short: Must be at least the valve travel time ({valve_time} s).
error.vent_max_below_pause: Must be at least the shortest pause.

fault_safe.title: Heating is in fault state
fault_safe.description: The boiler was switched to the safe state: {reason}. Heating is off and the valves are in their idle position. The system returns by itself once the boiler is available and follows commands again.

sensor_failure.title: Temperature sensors of {room} failed
sensor_failure.description: No temperature sensor of {room} has a valid value. The room runs in the fallback mode from its settings. Check the sensors or change them in the room settings.

no_heat.title: Boiler runs but does not heat
no_heat.description: The boiler has run for {minutes} min but the water temperature has not risen by {rise} °C. Check the boiler (fault, water pressure), a closed circuit or air in the system. The issue clears by itself when the water warms up again while the boiler runs.

valve_not_opening.title: Valve does not seem to open: {room}
valve_not_opening.description: Valve {entity} in {room} should be open and the boiler heats, but the pipe at the valve did not warm up. Check the head and the valve. The issue clears when the check passes.

valve_not_closing.title: Valve does not seem to close: {room}
valve_not_closing.description: Valve {entity} in {room} should be closed, but the pipe at the valve warms up. Check the head and the valve. The issue clears when the check passes.

start_manual.name: Start manual heating
start_manual.description: Heats for the given time, regardless of the room demand.

generate_dashboard.name: Generate dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Returns a dashboard for this installation. Copy the response into a new dashboard (raw configuration editor).

ventilate.name: Air
ventilate.description: The rooms do not heat, their valves are closed. When airing already runs, the time is added.

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: Room thermostats or Airing switches (room, floor, whole house). Without any, the whole house.

minutes.name: Time
minutes.description: Without it, the time from the settings.

stop_ventilation.name: Stop airing
stop_ventilation.description: The rooms heat to their targets again.

entity_id.description: Room thermostats or Airing switches (room, floor, whole house). Without any, the whole house.
